metadata.description: Voice mode for Claude Code — speak text aloud and have Claude read its replies, via edge-tts Microsoft neural voices (free, no API key; text is sent to Microsoft's Edge read-aloud service).

plugins.name: voice-mode
plugins.description: Hear Claude talk. One-off text-to-speech on demand, plus an opt-in auto-speak mode (Stop hook) that reads every reply aloud — session-scoped so only one window speaks. Free Microsoft neural voices via edge-tts (no API key; text is sent to Microsoft's Edge read-aloud service), English + Polish auto-detect, silent playback.
